Game Overview

At its heart, Metro Escape is a escape game about navigate a dark and mysterious metro station teeming with secrets. Discover hidden items, solve complex puzzles, and unravel riddles to escape. Immerse yourself in a haunting atmosphere where flickering lights and whispers amplify the suspense. Test your wits and ingenuity in this captivating adventure.
